businesses.business: workers' compensation cost containment and risk management services

offering_description.value: Provides managed care and claims management services that help employers, insurers and third-party administrators control workers' compensation, auto and health claim costs. Services are delivered by nurses, adjusters and bill review staff using proprietary technology and provider networks.

primary_services.value: claims management; medical bill review; managed care and case management; pharmacy benefit management; network solutions and utilization review

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, self-insured organizations; B2G: self-insured state and local government entities

end_markets.value: workers' compensation insurance; property and casualty insurance; employer health and disability; government risk management

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for claims administration, bill review, case management and network services, often per claim or per transaction

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in claims and medical bills from payers and employers, delivers adjudication, review and care coordination services back to them

geography_served.value: US national: Offices and clients across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: claims management, bill review, managed care, pharmacy and network services for payers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to employers, insurers and third-party administrators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state workers' compensation rules, licensing for adjusters and managed care, pharmacy rules, HIPAA privacy
